note: A capability is what you want to do; a service is a container. CHRIST resolves the first into the second, so nobody has to remember the second.

capabilities.name: Voice plane
capabilities.about: Cantus on one socket: calls, media, routing, the browser softphone. Everything else is a client of this.

capabilities.name: PSTN
capabilities.about: A carrier, a DID, caller ID and the SIP border. Without it the switch still routes extension to extension.

capabilities.name: Platform (VoiceOps)
capabilities.about: Accounts, numbers, the routing document, voicemail, CDRs and the softphone — Telno, which fills zeus's role in this tree.

capabilities.name: Estate console
capabilities.about: The operator's window: live calls, lines, the routing document and the encryption switch.

capabilities.name: Model gateway
capabilities.about: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of every provider, local or hosted. Every AI capability below wants it.

capabilities.name: Voice agents
capabilities.about: Capstone (AgentOps) and dograh (the runtime that speaks). Their stack is large, so CHRIST attaches to it by URL instead of pretending to own it.

external.name: Capstone + dograh
external.note: docker compose up in apps/capstone, then point these at it. CHRIST wires its numbers either way.

capabilities.name: Agent memory
capabilities.about: claude-mem: what an agent did last time, compressed and injected into this time.

external.name: claude-mem
external.note: start it from its own repo and set the URL.

capabilities.name: Mail
capabilities.about: Loomix Mail over JMAP against your own Stalwart server — where voicemail and transcripts land.

capabilities.name: Training and service desk
capabilities.about: OnTrak: the graded range and the ticket queue a call escalates into.

capabilities.name: SMS
capabilities.about: OpenSMS turns an Android phone on your network into the SMS API. A phone is not a container, so this one is attached.

external.name: OpenSMS
external.note: run the app on the phone; set the URL it prints.

capabilities.name: Agent tools
capabilities.about: REA and ontrak-mcp: what an agent can do with its hands, over MCP on stdio.

external.name: REA
external.note: MCP server on stdio; the agent console launches it.

external.name: ontrak-mcp
external.note: MCP bridge on stdio; no port to publish.

capabilities.name: AI, all of it
capabilities.about: The bundle: model gateway, voices, memory and tools. This is the "I want AI" answer.
